summary: Regression tested GymTrack Pro (Expo web) after removing dangerouslySetInnerHTML in favor of document.createElement-based font injection in app/_layout.tsx. All 7 requested flows pass. Fonts are NOT falling back to serif: <style id="gt-web-fonts"> is present (276 chars), Google Fonts <link> for Oswald+Manrope is injected, hero <h1> 'TU DIARIO DE HIERRO' and section titles compute to fontFamily='Oswald, Manrope, sans-serif', body uses Manrope stack. Auth signup returns 200 (Blink), authenticated state entered. Level accordion (intermedio) expands. Calendar quick-log persisted a Pecho / 55 min / 2,500 kg / Fuerza workout; summary bento shows 1 entreno / 2,500 KG / 55 MINUTOS; reload preserves it. Filter chip and type-bar-fuerza chart bar are both tappable in Calendario and Progreso. Progreso range switches (month/year/all) work, kg total includes 2,500, type-bar-fuerza tap filters. Tab bar shows all 7 tabs (Entreno/Calendario/Historial/Plantillas/Progreso/Cuenta/Ayuda) and each navigates without crashes. Home hero button start-free-workout-btn opens a session screen. Dark theme intact.
console_warnings_observed: SVG polyline error: `<polyline> attribute points: Expected number, "M 50 20"` — a polyline is being fed an SVG path 'M ...' string instead of numeric x,y pairs. Likely in a chart component (progress volume 'Total' line chart or TypeDistribution). Non-blocking (chart still shows a non-zero point) but should be fixed to keep the console clean.
React Native Web warning: `Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.` — stray whitespace/text node inside a <View>. Non-blocking.

observations_on_requested_features.quitar_filtro_hint_on_progreso: After tapping progress `type-bar-fuerza`, the copy 'quitar filtro' was NOT found in visible DOM text (case-insensitive search). The bar is tappable and filter state is applied (volume chart re-renders), but the user-facing hint text that was expected ('quitar filtro') is missing/renamed. Please verify the copy — it may say 'Toca una barra' or 'Quita el filtro' etc., or the hint may only appear elsewhere.
observations_on_requested_features.start_free_workout_session_screen: Home hero button `start-free-workout-btn` clicks and navigates, but the exact string 'Nuevo Entreno' was not detected in the resulting screen. The nav succeeded (no crash), so likely just different title casing/copy. Worth confirming visually.
observations_on_requested_features.calendar_type_filter_active_state: Tapping `type-bar-fuerza` inside Calendario does re-render, but `aria-pressed` on `calendar-filter-fuerza` is null and there's no obvious active-state attribute. Consider setting aria-pressed='true' on the active chip for a11y + easier testability.

action_items: Fix SVG polyline in chart: it's being passed an SVG-path string ('M 50 20') where numeric 'x,y x,y' points are expected. Check TypeDistribution / volume 'Total' line chart on Progreso.
Remove stray text node inside a <View> causing RN-Web console warning.
Add/verify 'quitar filtro' hint copy on Progreso when a type filter is active via chart bar tap.
Add aria-pressed on `calendar-filter-*` chips for active state (a11y + testability).
critical_code_review_comments: useWebFonts() migration from dangerouslySetInnerHTML to document.createElement is correct and confirmed working; add an idempotency guard (already present via id='gt-web-fonts') — verified only one style tag is created.
Consider preconnect <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com"> to reduce FOUT on cold web load.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows executed; ~95% pass (2 minor copy/aria items)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Font injection regression is fully cleared. Two console warnings remain (SVG polyline points string, RN-Web stray text node). Auth requires network to https://blink.new which is reachable from the preview. Modal save button can be below the fold at 1400x900 — use scroll_into_view_if_needed before clicking calendar-form-save-btn. Tab bar labels are title-case in DOM but CSS-uppercased; use case-insensitive selectors.
